Name: Industry Networking Night
Desc: Join us for an evening of networking with industry professionals from the energy, pharmaceutical, and biotech sectors. Bring your resume and come ready to connect. Business casual attire recommended.

Name: CHBE Plant Tour – Canfor Pulp Mill
Location: Canfor Northwood Pulp Mill Prince George
Desc: An exclusive behind-the-scenes tour of Canfor's Northwood Pulp Mill. See chemical engineering in action and speak directly with process engineers on site. Transportation provided from UBC.

Name: Spring Academic Help Sessions
Desc: Peer-led study sessions for CHBE 281 and CHBE 344. Upper-year TAs will be available for Q&A. Drop in anytime during the session window — no registration required.

Name: Annual CHBE Banquet & Awards
Desc: Our flagship annual event celebrating CHBE students faculty and the year's achievements. Dinner awards ceremony and dancing. Tickets available through the council — limited seating.

Name: First Year Welcome Mixer
Desc: A relaxed mixer welcoming incoming CHBE students. Meet your future classmates council members and upper years. Snacks and drinks provided. No registration needed — just show up.
